GPU temperature, power, fan and clock co: GPU temperature, power, fan and clock come from NVIDIA's driver (NVIDIA cards only). Windows doesn't give programs the CPU's temperature without a hardware-monitoring driver, so Daisy's App reads it from LibreHardwareMonitor when that's running with its web server on (in LibreHardwareMonitor: Options → Remote Web Server → Run, port 8085). Then CPU temperature and power appear on the Temperatures tile and in the log.

• CPU temperature and power on the Tempe: • CPU temperature and power on the Temperatures tile, and in the log
• Motherboard, memory, drive and GPU hot: • Motherboard, memory, drive and GPU hot-spot temperatures
• Fan speeds, voltages, power, clocks an: • Fan speeds, voltages, power, clocks and more in a Hardware sensors section
